description:
Cast Hyalopterous Lemure by paying {4}{B}.
When Hyalopterous Lemure enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hyalopterous Lemure by paying {0}, giving it -1/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the difference between Hyalopterous Lemure's power and toughness.
